author: Lon Hathaway
text: I recently used the service for our local American Legion that had an unusual situation. The owner and helper came out and we were able to determine the layout and problems with the system. Yesterday they (two men), showed up to evacuate the tank and it was along tough job due to the length of time since the last pump out. Josh was extremely thorough and explained what was happening and why. I would recommend LETO to anyone who needs this type of service.

author: Igor Yurchenko
text: Send me a driver ALEX and he is found what he found, just some lid , pump it out and problems wasn't solved. He said sewer line is clogged and  We paid him $425. author: T Z
text: Leto Sanitary Service installed my home's septic system over 10 years ago.  It has functioned well ever since.  Today I had a routine pump-out of the tanks.  The men that did it worked hard, were efficient, and personable.  The owner of Leto Sanitary Service, Jamie Granell, has always been very professional, responsive, and pleasant.  I highly recommend this company!

author: Evelyn Cabrera
text:
First, I would like to start by saying I LOVED LETO! They helped my parents at their home back in 2001-2002. Leto actually saved my parents tank because the prior company they used never opened the outlet lid. Fast forward to 2017, my husband and I purchased our first home. Realtor stated the septic tank had been emptied. Fast forward to Feb 2022, We were living in the home for 4-5yrs when I realized it had been so long and we haven't emptied. My husband and I decided to call Leto, just to be cautious because I knew what my parents had gone through with theirs. A Very nice gentleman came to empty the tank. Unfortunately, my husband was not able to get off work to be there, so I was. I asked the gentleman if we needed to open the outlet lid? He said "its not necessary". I explained "we had been living in the house for 4-5yrs, the house sat for about 2yrs prior. Not sure what it looked like in there". The gentleman stated "no problem I will let you know". (MIND YOU WE ARE FIRST TIME CUSTOMERS, HE'S NEVER BEEN TO MY HOME OR SEEN MY TANK). He did not have to open the outlet lid. Fast forward to March 2024, my tank is FULL!. We again call Leto, same gentleman came out. This time my husband was able to be there. My husband asked again if outlet lid needed to be opened. "No sir not necessary". Great! Fast forward to 09/09/2024, my tank is full. I called Leto, spoke with the VERY nice lady that always answers the phones, but she wasn't so nice this time. When I mentioned it had only been 4mos and the gentleman never opened our outlet lid to check for a filter, she got very defensive and said "I will have the owner call you. what day would you like to schedule?" I said "No ma'am you don't understand, we cannot shower or anything, I would like to see if someone can come out today?" She replied" On no ma'am, we do not have any opening today or tomorrow. It would have to be Wednesday" (3 days without being able to use my home). I said "Ma'am I am a returning customer, if this can't be done TODAY then I will be calling another company". She replied "well everyone is booked out to the end of the week so you're not going to find anyone sooner". I said "I AM A RETURNING CUSTOMER, YOU GUYS SUCK IN CUSTOMER SERVICE SATISFACTORY" She hung up. I assumed I would maybe hear from the owner but never did.
BUT I got my tank cleaned out, filter was cleaned and pipes jetted, all for the same price ALL ON THE SAME DAY! I found myself a new HONEST COMPANY!
